full_judgment: 14. Murshed J., as his Lordship then was, sitting in a Division Bench, said the same thing in Chikoni Bewa vs. Abdul Awal PLR (1964) 14 (Dacca) Dacca Series 557 where the learned Senior Special Judge summarily dismissed the petition of complaint considering the same to be unworthy of credit, It was held, referring to the aforesaid provision of law, that the learned Special Judge was bound to forward the petition of complaint to the Provincial Government, and, if he heard nothing from such Government for a period of sixty days, he should have proceeded to trial on the presumption that sanction was accorded by the said Government.
